name: Thought Shucker
description: Threshold -- {1}{U}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and draw a card. Activate only if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard and only once.
couldNotDerive: That this is an ACTIVATED ability at all (a plain {1}{U} mana-only cost with no tap/sac component isn't wired to any cost-bearing node), same known gap as Warren Elder -- the examiner read it as an automatic arrival effect instead.
Activation$Threshold (an activation-gate variant of the Threshold ability word) and GameActivationLimit$1 (a game-wide, not per-turn, activation cap) -- neither represented.
notes: Confirms and extends the known_gap_classes['Pure mana-only activated-ability cost (no T, no Sac<>)'] entry -- this card's WHOLE identity as an activated ability (not an ETB trigger) is lost because of it. Also surfaces two new, narrower gaps: Activation$Threshold (an activation-gate, distinct from the already-handled Condition$Threshold static-continuous shape) and GameActivationLimit$ (a game-wide cap, distinct from cond:once_per_turn's per-turn one). Not fixed this round -- the pure-mana-cost gap needs a real signature change (threading a pending cost through arbitrary effect handlers) to fix properly.
